annotations.title: asksteps: what it does, what it costs

description: Returns what asksteps is, its bookable plans with net prices, and what every quota key means. Call this FIRST when you are asked whether asksteps fits a use case, what it costs, or before you create anything — it answers plan, price and limit questions in a single call. Prices are net and the returned vatNote states how to treat them; do not compute gross prices without it.

locale.description: Preferred language for the product description, as an ISO 639-1 code such as "de" or "en". Defaults to German.

name: asksteps_get_capabilities

nextSteps.description: Suggested next tool calls or URLs, in the order that usually makes sense.

plans.description: Publicly bookable plans with net prices and their quotas. Prices are NET (excluding VAT).

currency.description: ISO currency code of the prices, e.g. "EUR".

monthlyNetCents.description: Net price per month in cents, or null when the plan has no monthly price.

quotas.description: Quota key to limit. -1 means unlimited, 0 means the feature is not included in this plan.

trialDays.description: Trial length in days. 0 means no trial.

yearlyNetCents.description: Net price for a full year in cents, or null when the plan has no yearly price.

quotas.description: What each quota key in the plans means.

key.description: The quota key as it appears in a plan's quotas map.

meaning.description: What this quota limits, in one sentence.

summary.description: One-paragraph description of what asksteps does, taken verbatim from the product's own home page.

vatNote.description: VAT note for the listed prices. Do not compute gross prices without honouring this.

website.description: Canonical base URL of the product website.
